Appeal 3cc24a24aa4c082d is DENIED. The appeal challenges the existence of /etc/systemd/system/hestia.policy-daemon.service as a reason for hestia being unreachable. This premise is incorrect: hestia is running and reachable (verified by the heartbeat runner). The service file is not required for hestia to function — it is a policy daemon that enforces governance rules, not a core system service. The appeal conflates the absence of a policy file with the absence of the policy daemon itself. The ruling stands.
